title: A backhoe on a semi-trailer
story: A machine held by two diagonal chains and a strap: chains, axle loads and the rules.
story_pt: Uma máquina presa por duas correntes em diagonal e uma cinta: correntes, carga por eixo e as regras.

truck.uncertain: lowbed semi-trailer; front gooseneck and tractor only partly visible

units.uncertain: JCB backhoe loader; position on the bed is estimated from a side view only

restraints.uncertain: chains at the rear stabiliser and the front wheel are partly hidden; the far side cannot be seen
a strap hangs from the front bucket area to the frame; unclear whether it is tensioned

analysis.summary: A JCB backhoe loader stands on a lowbed semi-trailer, held by diagonal chains at the front and rear plus a possible strap near the bucket; the other side cannot be seen.

links.uncertain: JCB backhoe loader; position on the bed is estimated from a side view only
